breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the contradictory boundary condition. The original prompt requested an inviscid simulation but incorrectly applied a 'noSlip' condition to the top wall. The ground truth corrects this to a 'slip' condition, which is appropriate for an inviscid wall. The generated specification repeated the original error, stating 'Apply the noSlip velocity boundary condition on the top wall patch.'
